mechanism.summary: When a named-property read first resolves an object-valued ordinary data property in compact small-object storage, install the existing object-identity and layout-version checked OwnSlot entry immediately instead of first retaining a weak cached value and waiting for that exact entry to go stale.
mechanism.generality: The representation is selected only by the live receiver's ordinary compact storage, the resolved own data-property slot, and the runtime value category. It does not inspect benchmark names, source paths, function identities, input values, iteration counts, or results. Dynamic storage, shaped literals, accessors, exotic receivers, primitives, structural changes, and unsupported values retain the existing cache or generic property path.
semantic_risks: preserving the exact own-data-property, accessor, Proxy, exotic-object, and inherited-property fallbacks before any cache entry is installed
validating both receiver identity and layout revision before every slot read so deletion, redefinition, property insertion, and storage promotion cannot expose a stale slot
preserving ordinary assignment visibility because value-only writes leave the slot live and the slot read returns the current value rather than a cached reference
retaining weak receiver ownership so bytecode cache entries cannot keep user objects alive
